purpose: Teach: ボウル/信州/舞踏/南極/ドリブル/遊園/ラスベガス/ポルノ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家でカフェオレをボウルで飲んでんのか?
lines.en: Riku — you're seriously drinking café au lait out of a bowl at home?
lines.style: Playful accusation with a sharp, amused edge. Eyebrow raised. Quick rhythm. Catching him in something ridiculous.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行で信州行ったろ?桜
lines.en: You went to Shinshu on that school trip, didn't you? Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting with a question of his own. Casual, almost offhand — pulling her focus elsewhere. Light, evasive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社交舞踏部に入りたいんだろ?
lines.en: Riku — don't tell me you want to join the ballroom dancing club.
lines.style: Teasing accusation. Leaning forward slightly, testing to see if he'll confirm. Warm but relentless.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、南極観測隊員に憧れてんだろ?桜
lines.en: You've been into Antarctic research teams for a while now, haven't you? Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle counter-reveal. Knowing tone — he's noticed something about her. Not mocking, just quietly observant.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のドリブル、上手いな
lines.en: Your dribble's actually pretty smooth, you know.
lines.style: Sincere compliment delivered casually, almost reluctantly. Brief pause before the word 'smooth.' Real approval underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ディズニーランドの遊園地行ったろ?桜
lines.en: You've been to Disneyland, right? Sakura?
lines.style: Another question-deflection, lighter this time. Stalling. Trying to keep the conversation anywhere but on himself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、ラスベガス映画見たろ?
lines.en: You watched that Las Vegas movie, didn't you?
lines.style: Quick shift of topic. Casual surface, but there's a thread of genuine curiosity underneath. Fishing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ポルノサイトには絶対近づくなよ、桜
lines.en: Stay far away from porn sites, Sakura. I'm serious.
lines.style: Abrupt tone shift to genuine concern. Firm but not harsh. The awkwardness of having to say something real. Brief, direct, protective.
